program_ambition.axis_1: Test whether named software-design principles, including SOLID-family maxims, are over-axiomatized beyond their observed conditional validity, especially when LLM-mediated engineering reproduces them as defaults.
program_ambition.axis_2: Construct an empirical alternative: context-conditional, rival-explicit, vector-valued, falsifier-preserving design laws that may recommend, reverse, or abstain.

directionality_gate: P4 must strengthen or bound the alternative law program in real engineering worlds; additional metrology alone is not mainline progress.

lane_A_real_implementation_transport.purpose: Replace synthetic provider semantics with real merged provider implementations while testing whether the five-site handwritten membership path recurs.

real_semantics_probe.reason: Merged implementation includes an upstream local-HTTP behavioral test and explicit Claude Opus 5 co-authorship.

lane_A_real_implementation_transport.transport_success: Actual merged additions repeatedly realize the five-site path, and the real Indigo implementation remains behaviorally valid when membership declarations are hypothetically localized to the frozen two-registry boundary without changing provider/form bytes.

lane_B_support_domain_boundary.purpose: Test whether CIL abstains in an independent ecosystem where integration membership is already localized behind a sufficient component/manifest boundary.
lane_B_support_domain_boundary.boundary_test: Handwritten runtime membership must be local to homeassistant/components/<domain>/manifest.json and component files. Central changes may be generated indices or non-runtime governance/dependency files, but no repeated handwritten central runtime registry should be required.
